CFML Language Reference: Functions

Decrypt

Decrypts a string produced by Encrypt, using the same key.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Decrypt(encrypted_string, key)

Parameters

encrypted_string
A string returned by Encrypt.
key
The key that was used to encrypt it.

Returns

The original string.

Usage

Decrypt cannot tell whether the key is right: with the wrong key you get gibberish, not an error. If you stored the encrypted value as Base64, decode it first with ToString(ToBinary(value)).

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Stored = ToBase64(Encrypt("Account 1999-A", "secret key"))>
<CFSET Restored = ToString(ToBinary(Stored))>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Stored in the cookie: <TT>#Stored#</TT></P>
<P>Right key: #Decrypt(Restored, "secret key")#</P>
<P>Wrong key: #HTMLEditFormat(REReplace(Decrypt(Restored, "wrong key"), "[^[:print:]]", "?", "ALL"))#</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Encrypt, Hash, ToBinary, ToString
